function: Synthesis and prediction of the multi-antenna multi-frequency channel matrix from the user location (location-to-channel mapping), also used for radio-environment compression (pp. 3, 11).
system: BS with ULA (64 antennas in main tests) and mono-antenna UEs; 3.5 GHz carrier, 50 MHz bandwidth, Ns frequencies; no RIS (pp. 3, 8).
method: Model-based neural network with Fourier-feature layer, complex MLPs and hypernetworks derived from a Taylor-expanded channel model; supervised regression with Frobenius loss (pp. 6-8).
data_channel: Sionna ray-tracing channels: D1 (Etoile scene, Paris), D2 (D1 without LoS), D3 (empty-scene LoS); 17.5k random training locations, about 210k test grid locations (pp. 8-9).
test_conditions: Trained on random locations (1.3 locs/lambda^2) in one scene, tested on a lambda/4 grid; frequency generalization: trained with Ns=32, tested with Ns=64 (pp. 8-9).
baselines: Learned only: complex MLP and complex random Fourier feature networks (Gaussian and model-based initializations); no non-learned baseline evaluated (p. 9, Table I).
metrics: NMSE (dB) over the test grid; compression ratio; frequency and antenna response plots (pp. 8, 11).
complexity: Number of parameters only: MB 9.1M, MB-u 851k, MLP 10.5M, RFF 669k; no FLOPs or runtime (Table I, p. 9).
q1_support: p. 8: "Realistic synthetic channels are generated using the Sionna ray-tracing library [55]" (D1 and D2 use the Etoile Sionna scene in Paris; public ray tracer, not one of the listed models, flagged for the reviewer).
q2_support: p. 9: "trained on the D1 dataset with Ns = 32, and evaluated on Ns = 64 frequencies" (Fig. 9, p. 10: NMSE is higher for the frequencies unseen in training but remains low).
q3_support: p. 9: "against baseline models from the INR literature" (complex MLP and RFF networks of Fig. 5 and Table I are all learned; OMP sparse recovery on p. 6 and ray tracing on p. 8 are only discussed, never evaluated).
q4_support: p. 11: "9.1 M learning parameters" of the proposed model; Table I (p. 9) lists the parameters of every model: MLP 10.5M, RFF 669k, MB 9.1M, MB-u 851k.
q5_support: p. 8: "Realistic synthetic channels are generated using the Sionna ray-tracing library [55]" (channels generated by the authors; no link, DOI or availability statement for code or generated data appears anywhere in the paper).
notes: Area 2: the learned function is synthesis, prediction and compression of the channel from the user location; UE localization (p. 12) is only a discussed application and is not evaluated. q1 is marked as met for Sionna ray tracing on its built-in Etoile scene, which is not a listed model, so the reviewer should confirm. q5 is 0 because Sionna and its scenes are public but the paper releases no code or generated data; the reviewer may reconsider if Sionna scenes count as a public dataset. q2 rests only on the frequency generalization test of Fig. 9.
